name: Cleanse Other
body:
School evocation; Level cleric/oracle/warpriest 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as cleanse, except you can cleanse either yourself or another creature. If used on undead or other creatures healed by negative energy, the spell cleanses with negative energy rather than positive.
